title: Triage verdict
description: The health verdict every platform (desktop Rust, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin) computes for one Kubernetes object. Field names are identical on all three. Display mapping: fail -> failed, warn -> warning, unknown -> unknown, ok + tone progressing -> progressing, ok + tone neutral -> neutral, ok -> healthy (redesign spec 11.1).

reason.description: The label shown to the user: the most specific cause (CrashLoopBackOff, 2/3 available), never just the phase.

ruleId.description: The rule in rules.md that produced this verdict. -000 ids are the no-finding baseline for a kind.

since.description: RFC 3339 UTC (Z suffix, no fractional seconds when zero). When the condition started, if the API says so.

severity.description: Present exactly when status is fail (critical or error) or warn (warning).

tone.description: Only with status ok. Absent means healthy.
